data.title: ZAKHELO (Slowed) - Official Music Video
data.description:
Hello everyone! I made this song to deliver a message to the world: “Peace is possible.”

This track tells the story of Zakhelo, a fictional anti war character who exists between realities, a voice that refuses violence and calls for unity in a divided world.

Every word in this piece is intentionally crafted as a fusion of "HIGH VALYRIAN"

Below, I’ve shared the personal meanings I’ve assigned to each part of the lyrics, a deeper layer behind the voice you hear.

Lyrics:
braka toriven shaa
Echoes of old wars remain

kloro ven ta ri
Conflict comes once again

draviko sen lo bra
Memories awaken inside us

tiro ka ven shii
The cycle begins again

Zakhelo  Zakhelo
No More No More

brivata no sen
Let go of all violence

toraka velio trin
Time holds the fallen souls

ska re voon te la
The world bends under pain

brin brin torava
Hearts beat in fear together

kelio sha dron
Voices rise against war

va ti  va ti  kro
We reach the breaking point

senari vokta li
A moment of awakening

tro venaka shii
We choose the path of peace!
